# Virtual Labor Force & Forge_OS

> Virtual Labor Force builds and deploys pre-configured, local AI hardware appliances pre-loaded with Forge_OS for businesses, developers, and creators in the Detroit Metro area (Oakland, Macomb, Wayne County).

## Core Offering: Owned Intelligence Hardware Nodes
- Philosophy: "Stop Renting Your Business Brain. Own Your AI." Eliminates monthly SaaS subscriptions by bringing local AI execution directly onto physical hardware on the customer's desk.
- Operating System: Forge_OS (Browser-native, local-first agentic OS running on Pop!_OS Linux).

## Hardware & OS Product Matrix
1. Forge_OS Standalone License ($297 - $497 one-time): Software installation script and license for existing NVIDIA/Linux hardware.
2. Tier 1 - The Spark ($1,799 retail / $1,499 pioneer pre-order): Compact PC, NVIDIA RTX 4060 Ti (16GB VRAM), Intel i5-13400, 32GB RAM, 1TB NVMe. Runs small models (8B–14B).
3. Tier 2 - The Pro ($3,299 retail): Mid-Tower Workstation, NVIDIA RTX 4070 Ti Super (16GB VRAM), Intel i7-14700, 64GB RAM, 2TB NVMe. Runs medium models (30B–70B) & multi-agent workflows.
4. Tier 3 - The Workhorse ($5,499 retail): High-end Workstation, NVIDIA RTX 4090 (24GB VRAM), Intel i9-14900K, 128GB RAM, 4TB NVMe. Runs large models (70B+) and heavy video generation.
5. Tier 4 - The Command ($11,999 enterprise): Enterprise Server, Dual RTX 4090 (48GB VRAM), AMD Threadripper, 256GB RAM, 8TB NVMe RAID. On-premise private AI cloud.
